description: This file defines a data class 'Report' with serialization attributes and an interface 'ILoadGrain' with methods for generating load and retrieving a report, specific to transaction management within the BenchmarkGrainInterfaces namespace.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Serializable data class tracking success, failure, throttling, and elapsed time metrics.

classes.name: ILoadGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain responsible for load generation and reporting in transaction benchmarking.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Asynchronously initiates a load generation with specified parameters.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current transaction report.
